content: Yen biru Efɑrɑimubɑ bɑ Gedeoni sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ sun kuɑ mɛ, ɑǹ sun sokɑ su nun somi sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ dɔɔ ɑ kɑ Mɑdiɑnibɑ tɑbu ko. Mɑ bɑ nùn ɡerusi ɡem ɡem.
Gedeoni u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, tɔn be i nɑɑ ɡirɑ i ɡo mi, i kuɑ n kere ye Abiesɛɛbɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn tiin tɔmbu bɑ kuɑ.
Bɛɛyɑ Gusunɔ u Mɑdiɑnibɑn sinɑm beni Orɛbu kɑ Seebu nɔmu bɛriɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, tɑɑ bi nɑ kuɑ buǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu turɑ bi bɛɛ i kuɑ sɔɔ. Ye u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɛ, yerɑ ben mɔru yɑ sure.
Gedeoni u dɑ
Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ
Yen biruwɑ Gedeoni u nɑ Yuudɛniɔ u ye tɔburɑ wi kɑ win tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300) ye. N deemɑ bɑ wɑsire. Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, bɑ wɛrɔ be nɑɑ swĩi.
Ye bɑ turɑ Sukɔtuɔ yerɑ u Sukɔtuɡii be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ bɛɛ kɑnɑmɔwɑ i mɑn dĩɑnu kɛ̃ɛyɔ bɑɑ fiiko nɛn tɔn be, bu wɑ bu di domi bɑ wɑsirɑ. Sɑ mɑɑ Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ, Mɑdiɑnibɑn sinɑmbu nɑɑ swĩiwɑ.
Mɑ Sukɔtuɡibun wiruɡibɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ sɑ ko wunɛn tɑbu kowobu dĩɑnu kɛ̃. Iǹ Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ nɔmɑ turɑ ɡinɑ.
Mɑ Gedeoni u nɛɛ, too, yɑǹ tɑɑrɛ. Sɑnɑm mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ nɔmu bɛriɑ, sɑ̃ki kɑ ɑwĩin sɛniyɑ kon kɑ bɛɛ so.
Min diyɑ u dɑ Penuɛliɔ. Ye u turɑ mi, ɡɑ̃ɑ tee niyɑ u mɑɑ ben tii kɑnɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn wisɑ nɡe mɛ Sukɔtuɡibɑ wisɑ.
Mɑ Gedeoni u Penuɛliɡibu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ̀ n nɑsɑrɑ wɑ mɑ nɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ nɑ wee, kon bɛɛn ɡidɑmbisɑ ye surɑ.

N deemɑ Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Kɑɑkoriɔ kɑ ben tɑbu kowobu bèn ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu (15.000). Beyɑ bɑ tie ben tɑbu kowo be sɔɔ, be bɑ nɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di. Domi bɑ ben nɔrɔbun subɑ wunɑɑ teeru (120.000) ɡo.
Gedeoni u swɑɑ mwɑ ye yɑ ɡbɑburu bɛwe, Nɔbɑki kɑ Yoɡbeɑn sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ. Mɑ u dɑ u tɔn be wɔri Kɑɑkoriɔ subɑru sɔɔ bɑǹ kɑ bɑɑru.
Yerɑ Mɑdiɑnibɑn sinɑmbu yiru be, Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ bɑ duki yɑkikirɑ. Mɑ Gedeoni u bu nɑɑ swĩi u mwɛɛrimɑ. U ben tɑbu sĩɑ ye kpuro burisinɑ.
Ye u ɡɔsirɑmɑ u wee, u kpɑwɑ kɑ Herɛsiɔ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡunɡunun bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Mɑ u Sukɔtun bii ɑluwɑɑsi ɡoo mwɑ, u nùn ɡɑri bikikiɑ. Mɑ ɑluwɑɑsi wi, u nùn Sukɔtun ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ yen wiruɡibun yĩsɑ yoruɑ tɔnu wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ yiru.
Mɑ u dɑ u Sukɔtuɡii be deemɑ u nɛɛ, Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ be wee, bèn sɔ̃ i mɑn kem sɔ̃ɔwɑ i nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i ko i nɛn tɑbu kowobu be bɑ wɑsirɑ dĩɑnu kɛ̃. Domi sɑǹ Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ nɔmɑ turɑ ɡinɑ.
Mɑ u wuu ɡen ɡuro ɡurobu mwɛɛrɑ u bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ sɑ̃ki kɑ ɑwĩin sɛni.
Yen biru u Penuɛliɡibu ɡo ɡo, mɑ u ben ɡidɑmbisɑ surɑ.
Mɑ u Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, durɔ be i ɡo Tɑbori mi, ɑmɔnɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ kɑ nun weenɛwɑ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe sinɑ bibu.
Yerɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn mɑɑbɑ mi, nɛn mɛro turosibun tii tii. Nɑ bɔ̃ruɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru, ì kun dɑɑ bu ɡo, nɑǹ bɛɛ ɡoomɔ.
Mɑ u win bii yerumɑ Yetɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ bu ɡo. Adɑmɑ bii durɔbu ɡe, ɡɑǹ ɡen tɑkobi womɛ bɛrum sɔ̃. Domi uǹ ɡinɑ kpɑ̃.

Yerɑ Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wunɛn tii ɑ seewo ɑ sun ɡo. Domi tɔn durɔn tiiwɑ u koo kpĩ u yen bweseru ko. Mɑ Gedeoni u seewɑ u Sebɑki kɑ Sɑlumunɑ ɡo. Yen biru u burɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ ben yooyoosun wĩinɔ kusiɑ u kɑ doonɑ.
Ye Gedeoni u kuɑ
win wɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑkiru sɔɔ
Yen biru Isirelibɑ bɑ Gedeoni sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wunɑ kɑɑ ko bɛsɛn wiruɡii, wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bii kɑ win bibun bweseru. Domi wunɑ ɑ sun wɔrɑ Mɑdiɑnibɑn nɔmɑn di.
Gedeoni u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑǹ mɔ̀ bɛɛn wiruɡii, nɛn bibu bɑǹ mɑɑ mɔ̀ bɛɛn wiruɡibu. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u koo ko bɛɛn wiruɡii.
Adɑmɑ kon bɛɛ ɡɑ̃ɑ teenu kɑnɑ. I de bɛɛn bɑɑwure u mɑn swɑɑ tonkunu wɛ̃ ni i wɛrɔbu mwɑɑri. N deemɑ Mɑdiɑnibɑ bɑ swɑɑ tonku wurɑɡinu mɔ, domi bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isimɛɛlin bweseru.
Bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ko nun wɛ̃ kɑ nuku tiɑ. Yerɑ bɑ bekuru ɡɑru tɛriɑ tè sɔɔ be kpuro bɑ swɑɑ tonku ni kpɛ̃ɛ ni bɑ wɛrɔbu mwɑɑri mi.

Swɑɑ tonku wurɑɡii ni bɑ Gedeoni wɛ̃ mi, nin bunum mu turɑ kilo yɛndun sɑkɑ. Ni bɑɑsi u mɑɑ Mɑdiɑnibɑn sinɑmbun wurɑbɑ kɑ swɑɑ tonkunu kɑ yɑbe ɡobiɡinu wɑ, kɑ mɑɑ burɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni nu rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben yooyoosun wĩinɔ.
Mɑ u bwɑ̃ɑroku kuɑ kɑ wurɑ ye, u ɡu yii yeru kuɑ win wuu Ofɑrɑɔ. Mɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru deri, bɑ dɑ bɑ ɡu sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Mɑ ɡɑ rɑ kuɑ Gedeoni kɑ win tɔmbun yinɑ.
Tɑɑ bi sɔɔ, Isirelibɑ bɑ Mɑdiɑnibɑ kɑmiɑ bɑ bu tɑɑre mɑm mɑm. Mɑ tem mɛ, mu wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ wɔ̃ɔ weeru sere Gedeoni u dɑ u kɑ ɡu.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Gedeoni, Yoɑsin bii wi, u dɑ u sinɑ win yɛnuɔ.
U bii tɔn durɔbu mɑrɑwɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkuru, domi win kurɔbɑ dɑbi.
Win kurɔ tɑnɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ Sikɛmuɔ u mɑɑ nùn bii tɔn durɔ mɑruɑ, wi bɑ yĩsiru kɑ̃ Abimɛlɛki.
Gedeoni u tɔkɔ kuɑwɑ kɔ̃ɔ kɔ̃ɔ mɑ u ɡu. Bɑ nùn sikɑ win tundo Yoɑsin sikirɔ Ofɑrɑɔ, Abiesɛɛbɑn temɔ.
Win ɡɔɔn biru Isirelibɑ bɑ kpɑm Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru deri, bɑ bũu ni bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑɑlibɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Mɑ bɑ Bɑɑli Beriti kuɑ ben bũu.
Bɑǹ mɑɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinni yɑɑye wi u rɑɑ bu wɔrɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmɑn di be bɑ bu sikerenɛ kpuro.
Mɛyɑ bɑǹ mɑɑ Gedeonin tɔmbu tɑkɑru ɡɑru kue, ɡeɑ ye u rɑɑ bu kuɑ kpuron sɔ̃.
